{
  "post_condition": "The function returns a new TracedOpenCodeProcess instance. Upon return, a globally unique event identifier event_id has been generated by new_event_id('opencode') and is stored in the returned object. The started timestamp is the current UTC date-time in ISO 8601 format obtained from utc_now_iso(). The paths opencode_log_path = _opencode_log_path(work_dir, event_id) and opencode_trace_path = _opencode_trace_path(work_dir, event_id) are computed and stored. A subprocess is launched and the resulting (proc, log_thread, stdin_thread) tuple from _start_opencode_process(proj_dir, work_dir, event_id, command, opencode_log_path) is held in the object; proc is a live subprocess.Popen instance whose stdout and stderr are being asynchronously captured by log_thread, and stdin_thread is actively forwarding input to the subprocess. Both threads are started and alive. All other attributes of the returned object (work_dir, stage, command, function_ids, input_files, output_files, summary, metadata) are equal to the corresponding arguments passed to start_opencode_traced. The input arguments are not mutated. No exception is raised given the pre-conditions. Formally: ∃ event_id, started, opencode_log_path, opencode_trace_path, proc, log_thread, stdin_thread : (event_id ∈ String ∧ StartsWith(event_id,'opencode') ∧ IsGloballyUnique(event_id)) ∧ (started ∈ ISO8601String ∧ started = utc_now_iso()) ∧ (opencode_log_path = _opencode_log_path(work_dir, event_id) ∧ IsValidPathUnder(work_dir, opencode_log_path)) ∧ (opencode_trace_path = _opencode_trace_path(work_dir, event_id) ∧ IsValidPathUnder(work_dir, opencode_trace_path)) ∧ (proc, log_thread, stdin_thread) = _start_opencode_process(proj_dir, work_dir, event_id, command, opencode_log_path) ∧ IsLiveSubprocess(proc) ∧ IsLiveThread(log_thread) ∧ IsLiveThread(stdin_thread) ∧ AsynchronouslyCaptures(log_thread, proc.stdout, proc.stderr) ∧ ForwardsStdin(stdin_thread, proc) ∧ result = TracedOpenCodeProcess(proc=proc, work_dir=work_dir, event_id=event_id, stage=stage, started=started, command=command, function_ids=function_ids, input_files=input_files, output_files=output_files, summary=summary, metadata=metadata, opencode_log_path=opencode_log_path, opencode_trace_path=opencode_trace_path, log_thread=log_thread, stdin_thread=stdin_thread) ∧ (∀ arg ∈ {proj_dir, work_dir, command, stage, function_ids, input_files, output_files, summary, metadata} : arg is unchanged after call)."
}
